title: First Day
body:
Used it for the first time today and it was a good experience. I got the Wild Coast scent and it really does have a blue/ocean tone to it, even though it's very woody and green when you first smell and use it. Hard to explain. Think of seaweed drying off on the rocks of an ocean coast. Salty, blue, and green. Very nice.
This body wash applies just like an oil cleanser. Which makes sense since most of the top ingredients are oils and Tallow. Don't expect it to lather like a regular body wash. It lathers into a thin soapy consistency. Little to no bubbles. Again, like a facial oil cleanser. So don't expect a crazy lather that's similar to your drugstore body wash.
 I did feel clean after the shower. The scent sticks to your skin and it lingers throughout the day -It's always nice knowing you smell good. Skin didn't feel dry throughout any time of the day. Sweat was regular and not extra smelly in any way. No rashes or burns.
I recommend this product if you're looking for an all natural body wash that works.

Okay, I am not the guy who ever paid attention to my skincare.  I’m a mans man.  Skin care is for pretty boys.
And then I started having skin issues, in particular dry skin and a rash.  So I went to the doc, and they said to find better soap.
I tried a bunch, without any improvement, and was both annoyed and felt like I was wasting my money when nothing really worked better than my cheap stuff from the grocery store or target.
I got an add for this stuff and on a whim, decided to give it a try. I did the sampler and really liked the high sierra scent.  I’ve now made several repeat purchases, and this stuff smells good, my skin is less dry, and the rash went away.  So, I gave it four stars cause it’s expensive, but it works really well.  Just buy it.  You won’t regret it.

author: Dry Girl
title: Actual eczema relief
body:
Fighting my eczema flareups takes replacing all my scented items. However, I was using the same body wash as my partner to save money (and space in the shower). After many flareups this summer, I splurged on my own tallow body wash. I’ve already had some success with tallow balm, so maybe tallow body wash will help too? I’m a very skeptical consumer, as my eczema is sensitive & testy. However, I’ve fallen in love with this body wash. It actually does make me feel cleaner & moisturized after the shower. 1) It cleans better; I did a test wash on my extra sweaty pits. One pit with this wash, the other with my partner’s wash. This one actually makes me smell clean, not perfumey. 2) It’s soft. My partner’s wash feels slimy compared to this one, which feels more velvety. 3) Moisturizing; Another trial using this versus my partner’s body wash on my arms (which get real dry) and legs. After airdrying for 5 minutes, I could totally tell the difference. This one doesn’t make my skin feels like it’s shriveling. 4) They say the bottle should only last a month, but it’s lasted me 2. It doesn’t lather like my partner’s but after doing research, apparently lathering is NOT good (chemicals). I also use exfoliating gloves and I think that’s helping to not overuse it.

Idk if some can’t tell the difference because they already have soft skin, but as for a person with constantly dry eczema skin, this body wash made the biggest difference for me (hence this long review). Thank you for the relief!

5 out of 5 ★ product for Quality, Quantity, and Cost. 1000% recommend.

author: Todd Hitchner
title: Difference maker
body:
I am about a month into using tallow.  Local Revival was my first encounter with the product (via IG) and after quite a bit of researching i took the dive opting for Cedarwood because I lean towards woodsy scents.  I was not disappointed.   After about a month I can say I have noticed a difference, my skin is softer/smoother feeling and I dont feel the dryness I used to even though I used other "natural" soaps over big factory brands.  Im not a "lotion" user, I dont go for that unless my hands get dried out really bad (im a male what can I say) but I do notice a difference after using this.

Now I will address the "detractor" aspect which plagues a LOT of people, PRICE.  I went on the limb trying this. I totally believe in natural ingredients especially in a world that poisons us for the sake of profits.  For context I use a flat food grade silicone scrubber with low profile nubs as it were.   It takes me basically 5 pumps to shower, one for face and neck. 2 for upper 2 for lower.  I still have about a third of a bottle left roughly.  After purchasing my bottle of course I got flooded with Facebook ads for others (I shut IG down for other reasons) so of course I got an ad for a much cheaper product ($14/believe cheaper) so I tried it. Well it took almost 18 pumps to shower (yes I counted) because that product was SO watered down that most of it ran off my scrubber.  Local Revival is much more viscous and as long as it doesn't cheap out I stay but I absolutely love it. I shave in the shower and the soap helps immensely with a smooth blade shave.  Great product and a much better value than the competitors product. I love it so much I bought the gallon refill (in the glass jug because I hate plastics too,)  I know price is a huge issue for many but for those of us that can afford it, maybe if we help the business get along theyvwill be able to lower the price to help those who just cant be able to just can.  Support small business because big business doesn't gaf about you

title: Good Product With Clean Ingredients, But a Few Practical Drawbacks
body:
I really appreciate the limited and organic ingredient profile, as well as the glass packaging; these were the main reasons I purchased. The product is gentle and feels good on the skin.
Two things I noticed, though:

1) I find I need to use quite a lot of the body wash to get a sufficiently “soapy” lather. I understand cleaner formulations behave differently than conventional ones, but it still requires more than expected to be effective.
2) While I love the glass bottle, it would be much safer in the shower if it came with a silicone base. Glass on wet surfaces can get slippery, and brands like Fountain Head include silicone sleeves to prevent slipping and improve stability.
Overall, it’s a quality product, but these improvements would make the experience significantly better.

author: Erin O.
title: With this wash, my skin felt hydrated on its own. That surprised me.
body:
I’ve only used this body wash a handful of times, but I already notice a real difference. I have sensitive skin, and most body washes — especially anything with added fragrance — tend to leave me dry or irritated. Living in Colorado’s dry climate just adds to it. Normally, I step out of the shower and feel that tight, flaky skin unless I lotion immediately.
With this wash, my skin felt hydrated on its own. That surprised me.
The formula feels clean and uncomplicated, and it’s thick in texture. It comes in a glass bottle, which honestly made me nervous for shipping, but it showed up perfectly packed. My only question is whether the thickness will eventually clog the pump — too soon to know, but worth mentioning.
I ordered the unscented version thinking that was my safest bet, and it really is just… neutral. Not bad, not good, just plain — which is fine, especially if you’re sensitive like I am. But now that I realize they actually offer scented blends made with essential oils, I’m kicking myself a little. A subtle fragrance in the shower really does something for my mood, and I’m definitely going to try one of their blends next time.
Their three scents — Local Revival, Wild Coast, and High Sierra — all sound incredible, and honestly any of them would have added that extra “wash the stress off” feeling I love during a shower. So that’s my plan when it’s time for a refill.
Overall, this is one of the most moisturizing and gentle body washes I’ve tried, even after just a few uses. I wasn’t expecting to notice a change this quickly, but I’m impressed.

body:

body: I’m going to start by saying that I have super sensitive skin. I am prone to eczema flairs, dry skin and irritation. My youngest daughter is as well. We’ve been long time users of handmade natural soaps and soap bars but they still always leave my skin feeling dry and tight. I have been using another liquid soap that’s natural from a company in the Bay Area that I thought was working really well. That was until I tried local revival. My skin genuinely feels hydrated after I shower. And that NEVER happens. It’s not just feeling clean, but it feels like the soap is actually doings something to heal my skin. My skin looks less red and it feels softer. Even my body oils after the shower seem to absorb better. I kept saying I was going to switch back to the other brand after finishing a bottle but then I just keep coming back to order more! My only “problem” with local revival is the scents are super mild. But that’s not even an issue because the scents are still so nice. They are just more subtle. It is something some people might find difficult to adjust to when they are used to using heavily fragranced products. Regardless of that though I don’t think I will be switching back to my other soap. Everyone in my house LOVES this body wash and my skin has never felt better!

body:

First time I used it I felt squeaky clean and not as moisturized as I thought I would but…. After a couple more uses my skin was back to being hydrated post shower and not dried out! There are many times I forget to put my tallow moisturizer on directly after my shower because my skin is not tight and cranky. Only downside I would say for me is that the lather does not go far. I have to use a couple of pumps if I want the lather (I use silicone scrubbie and exfoliating gloves). I can truly say I love this product… will be a continued product for me! 
If your skin is in bad shape prior to starting this like mine was it will take a few showers to benefit your skin. 
My hubby says he feels the same as me but his skin is naturally oily and he does not feel oily with the THBW but moisturized. (That is high praise, he usually wants the “dry me out” stuff!)

I love that there's a bulk refill option but there's other scents Id like to try before I get a refill. I have had the bottle since July and I'm right above halfway. I use an African net sponge to exfoliate. Before with any other soap, I couldn't use it ever day. Other soaps are too drying for my skin so trying to exfoliate made my skin "itch" afterwards. It's not a pleasant feeling if you know what I'm talking about. But with this soap, I can use the net sponge every day. I have keratosis pilaris (commonly called chicken skin) on the backs of my arms & on my legs. It's been there since I was a baby and nothing over the years has seemed to help. I do believe this soap has helped though. It's not completely gone but the bumps are not as raised now. Being able to exfoliate regularly is also helping this too. title: YES
body:
This body wash surprised me in the best way! I was nervous to try a body wash with tallow as a main ingredient because I've bought one tallow product before from a different company and even though they guaranteed that it only smelled like vanilla, it smelled like straight up pot roast. I'm pregnant right now and my sense of smell is very sensitive – I CAN smell some faint beefiness, but it's pleasantly overpowered by yummy almond and vanilla, and it dissipates very quickly. I can't smell it on me after I get out of the shower either. I love the almond vanilla scent I got, but I'm also excited to try the other scents, especially blue citrus and toasted sugar.

It also surprised me that my skin doesn't feel dry after getting out of the shower. Living in a super dry climate (Utah) my skin is always struggling, but this has helped a lot. 

I looove the bottle and pump. The brown bottle (with the beige silicone around it) is a great neutral, and the black pump works super well and feels sturdy. I plan to keep this for a long time and refill it over and over again.

Oh, and THANK YOU for making the bottle out of glass!!!! PLASTIC IS DEAD TO ME

author: Jennifer Gossett
title: Almond Vanilla - Local Revival - Silicone Sleeve
body:
I received my order quickly—placed on 4/4 and delivered on 4/10. The packaging was secure and kept the glass bottle safe. After reading other reviews, I decided to order the silicone sleeve as well, and I’m really glad I did. It definitely gives me more peace of mind with the glass bottle. I understand the trade-off, and I agree that the potential “risk” is worth avoiding the toxins found in plastic. Offering the sleeve is a great solution.

The Almond Vanilla scent is a bit different than I expected—it leans more sweet, almost like a dessert, rather than a traditional candle-like fragrance. Not bad at all, just different. I haven’t opened the Local Revival bottle yet, so I can’t speak to that scent.

In the shower, it’s true that it doesn’t lather like a typical body wash. However, using a loofah helps a lot—it holds the product better and creates more suds. I use about three pumps, which is enough for full coverage.

As for the pump itself, I didn’t have any issues, though I was mindful of other reviews. I unscrewed it before inserting it into the bottle and made sure everything was aligned properly—it works perfectly.

Now for the most important part: I have extremely dry skin on my arms and legs (elbows to hands, knees to feet). If I don’t use lotion, my skin looks very ashy—but I’ve never liked lotion because of the sticky feeling, and honestly, it seems to make dryness worse over time unless you keep reapplying.

Today is 4/14, and after just four days of daily use, I’m genuinely shocked at the difference. My skin is soft, hydrated, and no longer ashy. The tallow really absorbs and makes a noticeable difference. I haven’t needed lotion at all—which is a huge win for me.

As for the price, yes, it’s on the higher side—but in my opinion, it’s absolutely worth it.

Local Revival has earned a very happy new customer.
